name: Tallinn Song Festival Grounds
description: An open-air arena with a large arched stage, home to Estonia’s national song festivals and the 1988 Singing Revolution gatherings.

name: Toompea Castle
description: The castle on Toompea Hill above the old town. Its pink Baroque wing is now the seat of the Estonian parliament.

name: Hotel Viru
description: A Soviet-era hotel for foreign visitors, opened in 1972. A museum on its top floor shows the room the KGB used to listen in on guests.

name: Fat Margaret
description: A round 16th-century cannon tower by the old town’s sea gate. It now holds the Estonian Maritime Museum.

name: Great Guild Hall
description: The 15th-century hall of the merchants’ guild, now home to the Estonian History Museum.

name: Tallinn Town Hall
description: A Gothic town hall from the early 1400s on the old town’s main square, topped by a weather vane known as Old Thomas.

name: Linnahall
description: A concrete concert and sports hall on the waterfront, built for the 1980 Moscow Olympics sailing events and now largely unused.
